name: com.ufcalendar/fight-api
title: UFCalendar Fight API — MMA MCP server
description: MMA MCP: UFC, PFL, BKFC, RIZIN, OKTAGON results, stats, rankings, scorecards. Free plan, no card.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: List the UFCalendar Fight API plans, their monthly request quotas and per-minute limits, including the free plan (100 requests a month, no card). Answers "what does this cost" without a credential.

tools.name: list_orgs
tools.description: List the promotions the UFCalendar Fight API covers, with per-org capability flags (stats, rounds, rankings, broadcasts, predictions, scorecards, odds). Odds are the UFCalendar consensus line: information only, not betting advice.

tools.name: how_to_connect
tools.description: Explain how to authenticate against the UFCalendar Fight API from this MCP server: an API key bearer token, or signing in with a UFCalendar account. Returns the URLs to do it.

tools.name: get_org
tools.description: Fetch one promotion by slug (ufc, pfl, oktagon, bkfc, rizin or ksw): name, short name, country, website and its capability flags (stats, rounds, rankings, broadcasts, predictions, scorecards, odds; odds are information only, not betting advice). list_orgs returns the same rows for every promotion without a credential.

org.description: Promotion slug.

tools.name: get_division
tools.description: One weight class in one promotion: the current rankings board when the promotion publishes one, upcoming bouts booked at that weight, the most recent results and the active roster by recency. The division-page answer in one call.

org.description: Promotion slug.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List fight cards by promotion, status and date range. A bare call returns the upcoming schedule, soonest first; pass order=desc for the archive, newest first. Filter to title cards or PPVs with is_title_card / is_ppv, and pass include=headline for each card's main event (and its result once fought) in the same call. Cursor paginated.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

status.description: Filter by event status. upcoming = every card not yet over (announced, scheduled or live), soonest first.

order.description: asc = soonest first (default for upcoming), desc = newest first.

is_title_card.description: Only cards with (true) or without (false) a title bout.

is_ppv.description: Only pay-per-view cards (true) or non-PPV cards (false).

include.description: headline = each event's main event (both corners, division, title flag and the result once fought) in the same call.

tools.name: get_next_event
tools.description: The single next upcoming card for one promotion, or across all of them: the soonest event that has not finished. For UFC, developmental sub-series cards (Dana White's Contender Series, Road to UFC) are skipped while a numbered card or Fight Night is booked; pass skip_series=false to include them. Pass include_card=true to get the full bout list in the same metered call.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for the next card across every covered promotion.

skip_series.description: UFC only: skip Dana White's Contender Series and Road to UFC cards while a numbered card or Fight Night is booked. Default true.

include_card.description: Also return the full bout order, venue and broadcasts (same shape as get_event_card). Default false.

tools.name: get_event_card
tools.description: Fetch one event by slug or id with its complete bout order, both corners, venue, broadcast listings and results when the card has been fought. Pass include=eta for per-bout estimated start times and include=odds for each bout's current UFCalendar consensus odds line (information only, not betting advice).

include.description: eta = an estimated start time on every bout (estimates, not a schedule; re-anchored on each completed bout). odds = each bout's latest UFCalendar consensus line (information only, not betting advice).

tools.name: get_event_changes
tools.description: The audit trail for one card: bouts added or cancelled, opponents swapped, start times moved, fighter profiles merged — newest first.

tools.name: get_event_live
tools.description: The real-time state of a card on fight night: every bout's status, the bout in the cage (round, running clock, unofficial strike and takedown totals per round, referee, a timestamped action timeline) and the last result as soon as it is posted. data is null when nothing is being streamed. UFC fight nights, Contender Series included. For push delivery, connect to the WebSocket wss://live.ufcalendar.com/v1 with the same key. Pro plans and up.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: The cross-event change feed, newest first: bouts added, cancelled or reinstated, opponents swapped, start times or venues moved, fighter profiles merged — across every covered promotion or one of them, since a date (default the last 90 days). The same audit trail webhooks deliver, for agents that poll instead.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

since.description: Only changes observed at or after this point: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO-8601 datetime. Default: 90 days ago.

tools.name: how_to_watch
tools.description: Who airs one event, country by country: the promotion's rights deals merged with the event's own confirmed broadcast listings, with provider, kind (tv, stream, ppv…), link and a worldwide row. Pass a two-letter country code to get that market plus worldwide. Series-aware, so a Contender Series card shows its own deal, not the numbered-card one.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. "US" — that market plus the worldwide row. Omit for every country.

tools.name: get_event_storylines
tools.description: The talking points of one card, computed from the record: title fights and title eliminators, the closest bout by UFCalendar's model, rematches and trilogy deciders, who is on a streak, who is debuting or returning from a long layoff, the ranked fighters and champions on the card, nations represented, the tallest and longest-reach fighters and the fastest career finish on the bill.

tools.name: get_pickem_splits
tools.description: How the UFCalendar community is picking each bout on one card: picks for each corner, the total and the percentage, in card order. Crowd sentiment from our own pick'em game, not a market and not a forecast.

tools.name: get_event_odds
tools.description: The UFCalendar consensus odds line for every bout on one card, in card order: the current line, the opening line, the closing line once a bout is settled, and how far the market moved since opening, each with how many sportsbooks backed it, plus every bout's prop markets (method of victory, total rounds, goes the distance). Unpriced bouts are listed with nulls. Book identities are never exposed. Information only, not betting advice.

tools.name: get_fight_odds
tools.description: The UFCalendar consensus odds line for one bout: the current line, the opening line, the closing line once the bout is settled, and the movement since opening in implied-probability points, each point with its American and decimal price, implied and margin-removed probability and how many sportsbooks backed it. Also the prop markets: method of victory per corner (KO/TKO, submission, decision), total rounds over/under per line and whether it goes the distance. Book identities are never exposed. Information only, not betting advice.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: get_odds_history
tools.description: Every UFCalendar consensus odds point recorded for one bout, oldest first: the line-movement series, with how many sportsbooks backed each point. A point is stored only when the line moves. Narrow with from/to dates; cursor paginated. Pro plans and up. Information only, not betting advice.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: get_fight
tools.description: Fetch one bout by id. Pass include=stats for per-fight totals, include=rounds for round-by-round statistics, include=scorecards for the official judges’ cards, include=odds for the current UFCalendar consensus odds line (the closing line once the bout is settled) (information only, not betting advice).

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

include.description: Extra blocks to fetch in the same call. odds = the latest UFCalendar consensus line (information only, not betting advice).

tools.name: get_fight_stats
tools.description: Per-fight totals for both corners of one bout (strikes by target and position, takedowns, knockdowns, control and position time), each with UFCalendar fantasy points and their category breakdown, plus data-quality flags in meta.quality (rounds present, position data present, whether the round sums match the totals).

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: get_fight_timeline
tools.description: The official in-fight log of one settled UFC bout (June 2013 onward): every logged action in order (round starts and ends, takedowns and attempts, knockdowns, submission attempts, reversals), the referee stoppages paired with their reason (eye poke, low blow, doctor check or other) and real length, and every confirmed foul of the bout. The log labels only eye pokes and low blows, so any other foul (an illegal knee to a grounded opponent, an upkick, a headbutt, a bite, a fence grab) is reported when the athletic commission's point deduction or the official result confirms it: each stoppage says whether it was a foul, which foul, which record confirms it (log, deduction or result), who committed it, the points deducted and whether the bout ended on it; a stoppage logged as "other" with no record behind it is never a foul. Stoppage reasons are logged from December 2018. A recorded foul is not a ruling on intent. Settled bouts only. Pro plans and up.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: get_fight_positions
tools.description: Where one settled UFC bout was fought and who held control (tracked reliably from 2007): seconds standing, at distance, in the clinch and on the ground, each fighter's control time by position (clinch, back, mount, side, half guard, guard), and strikes landed and attempted by position and target, for the whole bout and per round. null means not tracked for that bout, 0 is a real zero. Settled bouts only. Pro plans and up.

fight_id.description: Bout id, as returned on an event card. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: find_fights
tools.description: THE tool for last/first/most-recent questions — search completed bouts across UFCalendar's launch promotions by title fight, finish method (ko, sub, dec, finish), division, fighter, winner, main-event only and date range, newest first by default. One call answers "the last title fight to end by knockout"; never page the schedule for it. At least one narrowing filter is required; 25 rows per page, 10 pages deep.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

method.description: ko = KO/TKO, sub = submission, dec = any decision, finish = KO/TKO or submission, any = no filter.

division.description: Division slug ("lightweight", "womens-strawweight") for an exact match, or a name fragment.

fighter.description: Fighter slug or id — bouts this fighter was in.

winner.description: Fighter slug or id — bouts this fighter won.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Typeahead search across fighters and events in one call. Use it to turn a name a user typed into a slug you can pass to the other tools.

tools.name: search_fighters
tools.description: Search the fighter roster by name, nationality or promotion. Cursor paginated. Returns identity fields plus `roster` (the promotion's own published roster status: active, off_roster or retired); use get_fighter for the full record. With org="ufc", roster_status narrows to fighters the UFC lists as active, no longer lists on its roster (off_roster) or lists as retired.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code or country name.

org.description: Only fighters who have fought for this promotion.

roster_status.description: Needs org="ufc" (the promotion that publishes its roster): active = listed on its roster, off_roster = no longer listed, retired = listed as retired. As published by the promotion.

tools.name: get_fighter
tools.description: Fetch one fighter by slug or id: bio, record, career statistics and freely licensed portraits. Pass include=history for the full multi-promotion career timeline, include=stats, include=rankings or include=power_index, include=bonuses for the UFC bonus ledger, and include=credentials for grappling and wrestling pedigree, gyms and coaches (sourced, confidence-graded). Always carries next_fight and last_fight.

include.description: Extra blocks to fetch in the same call. bonuses = the UFC bonus ledger (FOTN/POTN/KOTN/SOTN counts and fights); credentials = grappling and wrestling pedigree, gyms and coaches, each row with its sources and a confidence grade.

history_limit.description: Cap the career timeline at the N most recent bouts.

tools.name: get_fighter_discipline
tools.description: The confirmed fouls in one fighter's UFC bouts since December 2018, both the ones the fighter committed and the ones committed against them: eye pokes and low blows from the official in-fight log, plus any other foul (an illegal knee to a grounded opponent, an upkick, a headbutt, a bite, a fence grab) confirmed by the athletic commission's point deduction or by the official result. Returns the counts by kind, the points deducted, the time bouts were stopped for them, fouls per 15 minutes, and every incident with the event, opponent, round and time, the foul, the record that confirms it (log, deduction or result), the points deducted and whether the bout ended on it. A stoppage with no record behind it is never counted. A recorded foul is not a ruling on intent. Pro plans and up.

tools.name: get_fighter_positions
tools.description: Where one fighter's bouts happen over their career: the share of cage time at distance, in the clinch and on the ground, and seconds in control by position (back, mount, side, half guard, guard, clinch) for the fighter and against them, over their settled bouts with tracked positions. Pro plans and up.

tools.name: compare_fighters
tools.description: Head-to-head in one call: both bios and career statistics, strike location and position mix, current win streaks, previous meetings, common opponents with each result, the booked bout between them if one exists, UFCalendar's model win probability for it and the Power Index ratings. The tale-of-the-tape tool.

a.description: First fighter: slug (preferred, e.g. "islam-makhachev") or numeric id.

b.description: Second fighter: slug or numeric id. Must differ from a.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: The official rankings board for one promotion, point-in-time: pass a date to read the board as it stood that day. Rank 0 is the champion. Pass a division to narrow it. Each entry comes with movement against the previous snapshot (is_new for a debut), and meta names the previous and next snapshot dates.

org.description: Promotion slug.

division.description: One division, e.g. "lightweight". Omit for the whole board.

date.description: Read the board as it stood on this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

board.description: Board name; defaults to the official board.

tools.name: get_champions
tools.description: Every current champion across the promotions the API covers, with the division and the snapshot date the board was published. Pass org (e.g. "ufc") and/or division (e.g. "lightweight") to narrow it.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

division.description: One division, e.g. "lightweight" or "womens-strawweight". Omit for every division.

tools.name: get_roster
tools.description: The roster as published by the promotion on its own athlete profiles (UFC today): every fighter it lists as active (or, with status, off_roster or retired), each with the division, the date the status was first observed (null when it predates our first check), the date it was last confirmed, the last bout and the next booking. off_roster means the promotion no longer lists the fighter on its roster; it does not say why. Narrow with division. Cursor paginated. Pro plans and up.

org.description: A promotion that publishes its roster ("ufc").

status.description: active (default), off_roster (no longer listed on the roster) or retired.

tools.name: get_roster_moves
tools.description: Confirmed roster moves as published by the promotion (UFC today), newest first: signed, left (no longer listed on the roster), retired and returned, each with the fighter, the previous and new status, and the window it happened in (between previous_checked_at and observed_at). Filter by since / until, kind or fighter. Cursor paginated. Pro plans and up.

org.description: A promotion that publishes its roster ("ufc").

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC) or ISO datetime: moves observed on or after it.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD (UTC, the whole day) or ISO datetime: moves observed on or before it.

fighter.description: Only this fighter's moves: slug (preferred) or numeric id.

tools.name: get_power_index
tools.description: The UFCalendar Power Index board for one promotion — our own rating engine, refreshed hourly, with peak rating and fights rated. Pass view=movers for the biggest risers over a window, view=peaks for all-time peak ratings, division= to narrow.

org.description: Promotion slug.

view.description: current (default) = active fighters by rating; movers = biggest risers over `days`; peaks = all-time peak ratings reached in this promotion.

division.description: Division slug to narrow the board, e.g. "lightweight", "light-heavyweight", "womens-strawweight".

days.description: Window for view=movers, in days. Default 365. days is snapped to 30/90/180/365/730/1825/3650.

tools.name: get_matchmaker
tools.description: UFCalendar's matchmaker: the fights worth making in one promotion, scored for rank proximity, momentum, competitiveness and story (rematches, eliminators), per division or across the roster. Our own engine over rankings, Power Index and recent form — not a list of booked bouts. Runs without the website's style-clash (Fight DNA) factor, so scores can differ slightly from ufcalendar.com.

org.description: Promotion slug (MMA promotions; bkfc has no matchmaker pool).

division.description: One division slug, e.g. "lightweight", "womens-strawweight". Omit for the cross-division board; meta.divisions lists the valid ones.

tools.name: whos_next
tools.description: For one fighter: the most sensible next opponents by UFCalendar's matchmaker, with the model win probability for each pairing and the score behind it, plus the bout already booked if there is one. Runs without the website's style-clash (Fight DNA) factor, so scores can differ slightly from ufcalendar.com.

fighter.description: Fighter slug (preferred, e.g. "islam-makhachev") or numeric id.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: One statistical leaderboard for one promotion from UFCalendar's Record Book rollup — career, single-fight, single-round, division or event boards across 57 metrics (wins, finishes, significant strikes, takedowns, control time, finish rate and more; the 9 discipline boards on fouls and stoppages need a Pro plan), optionally narrowed to a division, a country or active fighters. Ranked, with the sample size behind each value.

org.description: Promotion slug (required — boards are per promotion).

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 nationality, e.g. "BR" — fighters from that country. Not with population=active.

population.description: all (default) = everyone who fought in the promotion; active = a bout in the last ~18 months.

tools.name: get_record_book
tools.description: The Record Book for one promotion in one call: the top rows of every leaderboard, grouped by category — the all-time and single-night records an agent quotes. Narrow by division, country, active fighters or one scope.

org.description: Promotion slug (required — the Record Book is per promotion).

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 nationality, e.g. "BR" — fighters from that country. Not with population=active.

population.description: all (default) = everyone who fought in the promotion; active = a bout in the last ~18 months.

scope.description: One kind of board: career, single_fight, round, division or event. Omit for all.

top.description: Rows per board. Default 3 here (the whole book at 10 rows is ~140 KB); up to 25.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: What the database holds for each covered promotion, year by year: events, settled bouts and the share of them with per-fight stats, round-by-round stats, official commission scorecards and a UFCalendar consensus odds line (information only, not betting advice), plus when the latest result landed. Computed from the data, refreshed every 30 minutes.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

tools.name: get_year_stats
tools.description: One calendar year of a promotion (or all covered promotions) in numbers: events and title fights, finish methods and busiest divisions, the fastest finishes, the biggest upsets and Power Index climbers, the busiest fighters, host countries and the most-used judges.

year.description: Calendar year, 1993 to the current year.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion together.

tools.name: get_predictions_upcoming
tools.description: UFCalendar model win probabilities for upcoming UFC bouts, published about three weeks out and repriced at least weekly. Corner-stamped, so a probability is never shown against the wrong pair. Pass event= to narrow to one card. Informational model output, not betting advice.

event.description: Event slug or numeric id to narrow to one card. Omit for every upcoming UFC bout.

tools.name: get_broadcast_rights
tools.description: Who airs one promotion in each country: provider, kind and link. Pass a country code to narrow it to that market plus the worldwide row.

org.description: Promotion slug.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code; adds the worldwide row.

series.description: A UFC sub-series grid instead of the org-wide deals: dwcs (Contender Series) or rtufc (Road to UFC). For one event, how_to_watch picks it for you.

tools.name: list_judges
tools.description: The judge directory with career aggregates: cards turned in, rounds scored, 10-8s, split cards and lone dissents, plus the league-wide baseline rates in meta.league. Filter by name, promotion or a minimum number of fights.

tools.name: get_judge
tools.description: One official's career aggregates by id: fights and rounds scored, rounds scored 10-8 or wider, three-judge cards that came back split, lone dissents, first and last date scored, and the promotions worked. Same shape as a list_judges row; use get_judge_scorecards for the cards themselves.

judge_id.description: Judge id, from list_judges. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: get_judge_scorecards
tools.description: Every official card one judge has turned in, newest first: per-round points, card totals, decision type and point deductions. Each row flags lone dissents and split panels and shows the colleagues' totals. Commission records only.

judge_id.description: Judge id, from list_judges. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: list_referees
tools.description: The referee directory across the covered promotions, busiest first: bouts worked, promotions, first and last bout, finish rate, how their bouts ended (KO/TKO, submission, decision, other) and average fight time. Filter by name or promotion. The referee id is a slug of the name.

q.description: Name fragment; accents and spacing are ignored.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

tools.name: get_referee
tools.description: One referee's career aggregates by slug (e.g. herb-dean): bouts worked per promotion, first and last bout, finish rate, method breakdown and average fight time. Same shape as a list_referees row; use get_referee_fights for the bouts themselves.

referee.description: Referee slug from list_referees, e.g. "herb-dean". A name spelled the same way works too.

tools.name: get_referee_fights
tools.description: Every settled bout one referee worked in the covered promotions, newest first, with both corners, the result and the event. Cursor paginated.

tools.name: list_split_decisions
tools.description: Completed bouts decided on split or majority cards, newest first, with every judge's official card and the dissenting judge named — commission records only, across covered promotions or one of them, in a date range. Facts as filed; UFCalendar adds no verdict of its own.

org.description: Promotion slug, e.g. "ufc". Omit for every covered promotion.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: How many requests the calling account has used this month, the plan limit, the per-minute limit and when the counter resets — and, on an owner-granted trial, when the trial ends (trial_ends_at).

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Fetch one venue by id: name, city, region, country, capacity, coordinates and IANA time zone.

venue_id.description: Venue id. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Find arenas and venues that have hosted a covered promotion, by name, city or country. Returns id, name, city, region, country, time zone and capacity; pass the id to get_venue_events for what was fought there.

q.description: Venue name or city fragment, at least 2 characters.

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code ("US") or English country name ("Brazil").

tools.name: get_venue_events
tools.description: Every covered event held at one venue, newest first — upcoming cards on top, then the history. Same filters and row shape as list_events (status, from, to, order, cursor).

venue_id.description: Venue id, from search_venues or an event card. Integer or numeric string.

status.description: Filter by event status. upcoming = every card not yet over (announced, scheduled or live), soonest first.

order.description: desc = newest first (default), asc = oldest first.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search UFCalendar's own editorial archive — previews, recaps, investigations, fighter-pay and technique pieces — by keyword or tag, newest first, in any of the 13 site languages. Returns title, summary, tags, date and the canonical URL; pass the slug to get_article for the body. Betting editorial is not served.

q.description: Keyword, at least 2 characters: matches the title, summary or a tag.

locale.description: Site language to serve (default en); English when no translation exists.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One UFCalendar article by slug: full body in Markdown (client widgets removed), title, summary, author, tags and publication date, in the requested language when a translation exists (English otherwise). Betting editorial is not served.

locale.description: Site language to serve (default en); English when no translation exists.

tools.name: get_calendar_feed_url
tools.description: The three subscribable ICS calendar feed URL templates for one promotion — per event, per card section, or per bout at its estimated start — with a <your-api-key> placeholder where the key goes. Returns URL templates only, never the caller's credential; the human pastes the finished URL into their calendar app.

org.description: Promotion slug.

tools.name: list_webhook_endpoints
tools.description: List the signed webhook endpoints registered on the calling account, with the event kinds each one subscribes to.

tools.name: create_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Register an https endpoint to receive signed webhooks (event announced, fight result, card changed, event completed, odds moved: the UFCalendar consensus odds line on an upcoming bout moved 5+ points or the favourite flipped; information only, not betting advice). The signing secret is returned ONCE — store it before the reply is discarded. At most 3 active endpoints per account.

url.description: https:// endpoint that will receive the signed POSTs.

events.description: Event kinds to subscribe to; omit for all of them.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Replace the signing secret of one webhook endpoint. The old secret stops verifying immediately, so update the receiver first. The new secret is returned once.

endpoint_id.description: Endpoint id from list_webhook_endpoints. Integer or numeric string.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint
tools.description: Permanently remove one webhook endpoint from the calling account. Deliveries to it stop and its delivery history is dropped.

endpoint_id.description: Endpoint id from list_webhook_endpoints. Integer or numeric string.
